definitions.gloss: back cover (of a book or magazine)
definitions.explanation: The cover at the back of a book, opposite the front cover. Often carries the barcode, blurb, or a closing illustration.

examples.japanese: {裏表紙|うらびょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦バーコード→バーコード：10282_baakoodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a barcode on the back cover.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏表紙|うらびょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The price is printed on the back cover of the book.

examples.japanese: {裏表紙|うらびょうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あらすじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I decide whether to buy a book after reading the synopsis on the back cover.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back, reverse) + ⟦{表紙|ひょうし}→表紙：04351_hyoushi⟧ (cover). The ひ of ⟦{表紙|ひょうし}→表紙：04351_hyoushi⟧ voices to び in the compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏表紙|うらびょうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あらすじ: synopsis on the back cover
- {裏表紙|うらびょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦バーコード→バーコード：10282_baakoodo⟧: barcode on the back cover
- {裏表紙|うらびょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: look at the back cover

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{表紙|ひょうし}→表紙：04351_hyoushi⟧: cover; the front cover
- {表表紙|おもてびょうし}: front cover (used when contrasting explicitly with the back)
- ⟦{背表紙|せびょうし}→背表紙：15671_sebyoushi⟧: spine of a book
